[[Emi]] is [[Chiyo|Chiyo's]] twin sister and a childhood friend of [[Mhenlo]]. She is available as a [[henchman]] in some parts of [[Cantha]].

She is labeled as a "[[Cutthroat Henchman]]."

==Evaluation==
;Pros
*Effective at disrupting with a good damage output.
*Can inflict [[Blind]], [[Daze]] and [[Overcast]] on foes.
*Has two interrupts.
*Can remove conditions from self, but does it rarely.
;Cons
*Cannot inflict as much direct damage as [[Nika]].
*[[Temple Strike]] has a high energy cost.
*Due to the long recharge of Temple Strike, her only off-hand attack, she rarely uses [[Nine Tail Strike]].

==Dialogue==
Bukdek Byway (during [[Welcome to Cantha]]):
:''"From the time I was a little girl, I remember Mhenlo looking out for Chiyo and me. We were small for our age, and some of the older students enjoyed bullying us, but Mhenlo made them stop. I remember that I wanted to be a Monk, like him, but my father wanted me to be an Assassin...."''

Kaineng City towns and outposts:
:''"My twin sister Chiyo and I have been through much together. In our younger years, we learned from Master Togo and the Headmasters at Shing Jea Monastery, Mhenlo was one of our mentors and a dear friend. Isn't he the best? Now we work for the [[Suun|Oracle of the Mists]] out of the Nahpui Quarter as Adepts, a most important task indeed.''

:''Did you need something?"''

Divine Path:
:''"Perhaps we could take a trip to the northlands to visit Mhenlo! I think his friend Cynn and I will get along very well! What do you think?"''
